subject.title: feat(agents): add multi-pass context compaction with progress tracking

question: Should this PR land a hidden internal multi-pass compaction helper now, or should multi-pass compaction wait until the real compaction callers and public settings/API shape are approved together?
rationale: The branch includes useful wired pruning work, but its named multi-pass feature is not active in runtime callers and still changes exported compaction settings shape.

options.title: Narrow Before Merge
options.body: Remove the unused multi-pass helper/settings type expansion and keep only the wired pruning, cut-point, and summary-marker changes that are ready for review.

options.title: Wire The Feature
options.body: Keep the multi-pass helper only if the PR wires it into the runtime compaction lanes with fresh-install and upgrade/session-state proof.

options.title: Pause For Design
options.body: Use the open compaction architecture issues to decide the permanent multi-pass API before merging this broad branch.

recommendation.title: Narrow Before Merge
recommendation.body: Remove the unused multi-pass helper/settings type expansion and keep only the wired pruning, cut-point, and summary-marker changes that are ready for review.

likelyOwner.reason: sallyom is the live assigned reviewer and is best positioned to decide whether to narrow, wire, or pause this PR.
